notes.title: Devlog #19 - VFX Update!
notes.notes:
Howdy partners!

Today we want to showcase our brand new VFX! We decided to finally update them, and honestly, we love them. Right now we mostly have animal-related ones, but there is also a cactus and smoke of absolute deception. Enjoy!

1. Animal reactions

They show up when animals react to their surroundings and states, like sleeping, eating or being herded. The icons were hand-drawn on a cardboard-like texture and animated in Unreal Engine’s particle system, Niagara. We wanted to make them look as if the Cowboy himself scribbled them carelessly, without any fancy tools (let alone skills). We love the new update – they give out a cozy, homely vibe!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/2c437219283d923a4f656a7e095cbd2752ba4caf.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/b0302b52a94dda9280ecb3e90824bcbb1c9d1fdf.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/a230b7b600c276539709d4d827ecdb58882ffec6.gif

2. Smokescreen of Deception

Some of the inner workings of our game aren't exactly, uh, visually appealing. To combat this, we use a little trick called Smokescreen (it is not called that, we made it up). We use it in many different places. Here you can see the quest with Ruff Raymond, where the shooting range appears. Poof!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/a230b7b600c276539709d4d827ecdb58882ffec6.gif

3. Cactus juice

The cacti no longer bleed when being cut down! (Yeah, they used to do that. But now we un-placeholdered that!) It now has this beautiful, green juice splashing out of it. Not cardboard-like this time, we aimed for a little bit more realistic look with this one. They look way better now. Made using simple hand-drawn textures and some Niagara magic!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/498302bed4e6f32aa8516a1e51b95be39a1f715a.gif
 
4. The “Howdy Exclamation Point”

We also recently coded this feature where if an NPC has something you could talk to them about, an exclamation point appears over their head. For some time we had a simple placeholder icon there, but look a this new one – also hand-drawn, and also in that cute style that the animals and smoke have!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/ae19051f45117432b38e7aad419d2e47dea03b5d.gif

So what do you think? Don’t hesitate to reach out, comment, suggest, or share a laugh! Follow us and shoot us a message at our X (well, Twitter...) – @OddQubit. We’d also love to have you over on our growing Discord server – here’s the [link]. Happy trails, friend.

Wishlist “Cowboy Life Simulator” today!

notes.title: Prologues Release Date 6th January 2022
notes.notes:
With the prologue date announced, we would like to announce upcoming playtests, which will help us gain valuable feedback.

Join Playtests Here

Changelog

We completely changed ours AI when it comes to enemy NPCs and their shooting behavior. We also worked on AI of animals to increase its efficiency while keeping the performance well.


We also fixed our main quest storyline to present an exciting background and a nice invitation to the main quest storyline, telling a story of a former soldier struggling in post-war society.


We have completely changed our building system, from now you will be able to build multistructural households and then expand your ranch by constructing: chicken coops, cowsheds, pigsties, rabbit cages, sheepfolds, stables and many more!


We have added generic event system: our farm can be attacked by bandits, thieves, wild animals or can be affected by weather disasters.


Our garden system will allow you to plant many seeds and then manage them. As soon as they ready you can collect and resell them in the local market.


We have kept improving the day/night cycle to match the feeling of many cult classic western games.


 Our large landscapes are filled with many quests and valuables for you to plunder.

notes.title: The Sixth Devlog - Major Changes in mechanics
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=RBSOC9vS4JI;full][/previewyoutube]

We changed many things to make them look more realistic. For example, now, when you cut trees, you can see them fall, and you can pick up logs. Same with the mining mechanic, which involves a more realistic gathering of stone, coal, copper, gold, silver. We also worked on weapon animations to make them look smoother and more excellent. We also have changed our UI to make it look better and smoother, more user friendly.

notes.title: The Fifth Devlog - Getting Closer To the Release of Prologue.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775841/54f89f68dbb8988f04f11c7a9e7727e15febb9a6.png

We've made significant progress improving nearly all of the game mechanics, including more excellent animations in resource gathering and weapons that will have much better animations now. We will be closely getting to the stage of releasing a prologue that will show the game in much more depth than before, showing the beginning of the main storyline and parts of other levels in the world and sandbox in the ranch level.

Of course, we won't forget to add a working save system so that you can enjoy exploring and building your ranch in a more pleasing way.
